notes.title: The Sinister Set VR Horror Collection
notes.content:
Do you dare to overcome your fears and confront true evil as an Exorcist? Or become one of the restless undead, stuck in the afterlife? How about being deprived of your memories inside an abandoned skyscraper, or getting trapped in a dying spaceship? Maybe try to escape a haunted manor, or explore the derelict towns and run-down motels in America's deep south?

Now you get to do all this and more in [b]The Sinister Six[/b]: a bone-chilling collection of VR games no horror fan should miss!

Includes the following six titles, or the ones you do not own yet:
[list]
[b][*] The Exorcist: Legion VR (Deluxe Edition)
[*] Wraith: The Oblivion - Afterlife
[*] AFFECTED: The Manor
[*] Cosmodread
[*] Hinge
[*] A Chair in a Room: Greenwater[/b]
[/list]

Check out the bundle here:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/22798/]https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/22798/[/url]

[previewyoutube=YyJme-7qXyU;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: "Black Screen" Bug Fix
notes.content:
Wolf & Wood has just rolled out a bug fix  for a "black screen" issue that was affecting a small number of users for the episodic version of The Exorcist.  It was related to how some saved games were versioned. Thank you to those affected players who sent in their player logs to help us locate and exorcise this nasty little demon!   -   [i]Nota res mala, optima[/i].

If you have not yet experienced episode 1 but would like to dive in with all five episodes in their entirety,  the [u][b]Deluxe Edition[/b][/u] is available for all major headsets including Valve Index.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1156250/The_Exorcist_Legion_VR_Deluxe_Edition/

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30779809/f6676f7cf6f1a8a2f005f96c042a506e1afe3dcb.gif[/img]

notes.title: Bug Fixes & WMR Support Added!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30779809/aa19414b9e9580b7cab5aa692380824dc7d86d86.gif[/img]

Hello Exorcists! We just rolled out an update for all episodes yesterday.  Please make sure you download this patch before heading out on your next demonic encounter.

[b]Fixes & Improvements:[/b]
[list]
[*] An issue whereby some controllers would stop working after picking up the Holy Water in Episode 1 "First Rites" has been fixed.
[*] For those who prefer snap turn over free turning, swipe rotation on the Vive wands has been fixed.
[*] We now fully support WMR headsets and controller support has been added!
[/list]


[i]in nomine Patris et Filii et Spiritus Sancti...[/i]

notes.title: Index controllers, bug fixes, teleport improvements, etc.
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30779809/c9a217e7844eebec7f6b3c1ed6943e34406ef575.gif[/img]

Valiant Exorcists! Today we have rolled out some updates to the episodic version of The Exorcist: Legion VR.  Your feedback has been incredibly valuable.
[list]
[*] Index Controller support - Can connect index controllers at run-time without any issue.
[*] Fixed a "black screen" issue that was affecting a small number of users at start of game.
[*] Fixed bugs involving people getting permanently stuck in out of bounds.
[*] Added fail-safes for the crucifix occasionally disconnecting from the kit and becoming unusable.
[*] Fixed bug where hands would sometimes get stuck in the hover state and the player would not be able to make a fist.
[*] Improved crouching and fixed an issue where the play area marker wouldn't stay on the floor whilst smoothly crouching
[*] Improved teleport movement so players no longer have to look directly down at the floor to teleport.
[*] Fixed a retrieval issue that occasionally occurred with the secret artifact in Chapter 1 (Source of the Nile).
[/list]

For those of you who have not yet purchased any episodes, we want to let you know that we have released a Deluxe Version of the game which encompasses all FIVE chapters.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1156250/The_Exorcist_Legion_VR_Deluxe_Edition/

Happy Halloween! [i]In nomine Patris et filii et Spiritus Sancti.[/i]

notes.title: Chapter 5 Achievements Update
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30779809/aa19414b9e9580b7cab5aa692380824dc7d86d86.gif[/img]

Thanks to player feedback we were able to identify an issue which made obtaining "[i]The Tomb[/i]" achievement, (completing Chapter 5 with 100%) impossible unless done on the [u]first[/u] attempt.  That's too hard, even for us!

We've pushed out an update and Exorcists should now be able to make their way through Chapter 5 and obtain "The Tomb" achievement at any time, including 2nd and 3rd attempts. Who knows, you might just see something you missed before.

There are a total of five achievements in Chapter 5 including "[i]Lost Little Lamb[/i]", "[i]Afraid of the Dark[/i]", "[i]No Respect[/i]", "[i]Chapter 5[/i]" and "[i]The Tomb[/i]".

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30779809/19366549118a9f515301e09de33e63c28899d4d8.jpg[/img]
   
Many players have reached out to us regarding the "Puke" achievement.  We won't tell where the achievement is, but it is [u]definitely obtainable[/u], and only requires access to the police station.

notes.title: We've been nominated for a SOVAS Voice Award!
notes.content:
[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30779809/3704c2445de7e33a6c729e84f82197ef0fef5374.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30779809/19a1ac82d3ec088eaa4dd124e8b18e44495c6e93.png[/img][/url]

Our very own [b]Jenn Henry[/b] (who voiced that disturbing young woman in Chapter 1 "First Rites")  has been nominated for a 2018 SOVAS award for  [i]Outstanding Video Game Character, Best Voiceover[/i]. Who else got a shiver when she playfully whispers into your ear [i] "I'm heeeere" [/i]?  

You can also hear echoes of Jenn's voice drifting through the caverns of [url=store.steampowered.com/app/740592/The_Exorcist_Legion_VR__Chapter_5_The_Tomb/] Chapter 5, "The Tomb"[/url].  Big congrats to her and the rest of the incredible performers who helped bring these sinister characters to life.

[b]Fun Fact:[/b] If you'd like to see the full credits for the cast and crew, check out the mug shot board in the police precinct! 

[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30779809/de91b6a0614ab4b3d3872d226e78398e053c6749.jpg][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30779809/c0087b352b0a575e40b7f48c3363ea6879264809.jpg[/img][/url]

notes.title: The Exorcist: Legion VR Complete Series is live!
notes.content:
[h1]THE POWER OF CHRIST COMPELS YOU![/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30779809/0b9c81096abd012cc40845336815e0073d891f98.jpg[/img]

"[u]The scariest film of all time[/u]" is now the most terrifying VR experience of all time. [b]The Exorcist: Legion Complete Series[/b] is [b]now available[/b] and includes episodes "[i]First Rites[/i]", "[i]Idle Hands[/i]", "[i]Skin Deep[/i]", "[i]Samaritan[/i]" and the climax "[i]The Tomb[/i]".  You can purchase them all or finish the set if you own previous chapters.

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/5508/The_Exorcist_Legion_VR_Complete_Series_Chapters_15/

Journey through FIVE unique chapters, confront ancient Babylonian entities and discover hidden relics to upgrade your exorcism tools in each chapter. As you make your way through the shadows and hear whispers in the darkness, just keep telling yourself "it's only VR".

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30779809/f78620c928a83b3a98975964c575ee311e85e18b.png[/img]

[h1]UPDATES[/h1]

Now that we have fully launched there are several updates to the entire franchise including:
[list]
[*]Increased movement speeds for free-roam locomotion options
[*]Spanish language implementation for in-game text and dialogue subtitles
[*]Animation tweaks and improvements across all chapters
[*]Improvement to Chapter 4 artifact unlock for the Celtic Cross (have you found it?)
[*]Various bug fixes
[/list]
We hope you enjoy this adventure. [i]In nomine Patris et Filii et Spiritus[/i]...

notes.title: Chapter 4 "Samaritan" is LIVE!
notes.content:
[h1]Our longest, most immersive and (by far) most terrifying installment [b]IS NOW LIVE!![/b] [/h1]

You can purchase it directly from within the police precinct, or via the episode page here:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/740591/The_Exorcist_Legion_VR__Chapter_4_Samaritan/

[h1]A few notes as you explore the depths of the EPDF research center in Haiti:[/h1]
[list]

[*] Chapter 1 is required, and this story continues where Chapter 3 left off.

[*]This chapter requires you to [u]think[/u].  Take your time, and explore.  There are details, hints and backstory elements hidden throughout the chapter.  Some of this information might come in handy when it's time to make decisions.

[*]Use Father Bell's notebook in your inventory! The information inside is valuable.

[*]Use your phone to adjust your locomotion settings for free roam, free turning, or all manners of teleport.  Oculus  Rift users can change their settings to accommodate 360-degree tracking.

[*] When you return to the precinct at the end of the chapter, check out the evidence room.

[*][spoiler]No chickens were harmed in the making of this experience.[/spoiler]
[/list]

[i]Yea, though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death, I will fear no evil: for thou art with me; thy rod and thy staff they comfort me...[/i]

notes.title: Chapter 3 Announced, and a Teaser!
notes.content:
[b]We're pleased to announce the third chapter of [i]The Exorcist: Legion VR, [/i]entitled [u]"Skin Deep"![/u] [/b]  

This installment is guaranteed to chill you. Please check out the chapter page for our newly released teaser.

http://store.steampowered.com/app/740590/The_Exorcist_Legion_VR__Chapter_3_Skin_Deep/

In Chapter 3 you will encounter Abyzou, an infertile devil who has been blamed for infant mortality throughout the history of civilization. Many cultures have encountered her and she has been given many names, from Lilith in Hebrew to Medusa in Greek.

It's your task to force her to reveal herself, and send her back from whence she came!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30779809/9c27ae90af53b41b3d25bd7ee6533001cdf97e98.png[/img][img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30779809/95b711bcafe3212451075eb26c543a0a6315d84f.png[/img][img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30779809/3889d1828835a1e2eaf6e9bb5184c85895421412.png[/img]

We continue to be very appreciative of the community support for both Chapters 1 & 2, and we promise to deliver something very special with this new episode.

notes.title: The Exorcist: Legion VR is available on SteamVR now!
notes.content:
Jump into despair and terror with The Exorcist: Legion VR's first two chapters, available today!

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30779809/9136eef2cc2b41c62bd523f169ccc8c5c4697a62.jpg[/img]


Chapter 1, titled "First Rites" follows the detective of the story investigating the murder of Father Bell, a priest at the local church, only to fall into the evil trappings of a demon.

Chapter 2, known as "Idle Hands", has the detective head to an insane asylum to investigate the sudden psychotic episode of a school teacher, getting more than they expected as an outcome.

We've given a lot of thought on the best way to exceed expectations but also keep our price affordable for current VR enthusiasts, as well as newcomers. You've already spent considerable money on your VR headset and hardware. For that reason, The Exorcist: Legion VR experience is divided into 5 chapters, with the initial chapter, "First Rites" priced at a discount of $3.99 (20% off MSRP) on Steam for the first week of launch (through Black Friday weekend as the Steam Autumn Sale). We don't want you to wait for that Christmas sale; we'd like to you enjoy the game as soon as possible!

If you like the first chapter, Chapter 2: Idle Hands is available, concurrently, to purchase right from within your headset, in-game. You can pick up Chapter 2 as additional DLC or as a bundle and save even more! Subsequent chapters (3, 4, and 5) and will offer new environments, new demons, and tools you need to send them straight back to Hell at a later time. This is a full story and the first chapter is exactly that- the beginning of the adventure!

Additionally, we'd love it if you nominated us for the Steam Awards with the "Haunt My Dreams" Award!

notes.title: The Exorcist: Legion VR Comes To Oculus Rift and HTC Vive on November 22nd!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30779809/6db2bdeb3b5b2154ef92e16da8f51802c94e227b.png[/img]

Fun Train and Wolf & Wood are proud to bring The Exorcist horror franchise to premium virtual reality with The Exorcist: Legion VR. Based on the events of The Exorcist III, players experience a stand-alone story untold in the movies across five chapters. Chapter 1: First Rites and Chapter 2: Idle Hands are expected out November 22nd, with the rest following soon after. First Rites will launch at $3.99 for the first week during Black Friday, making it a 20% discount off the normal experience, with Idle Hands available at $4.99.

The Legion has come! A variety of demons have returned to our world just as Pazuzu (the main demon from The Exorcist franchise) promised. Follow in the shoes of a detective in Chapter One as they uncover strange details behind the grisly murder of a priest. Each subsequent Chapter takes the player further in the journey as they assume the role of a detective investigating the demonic entities lurking in the shadows, culminating in a satisfying ending for any fan of the franchise.

Five stand-alone episodic chapters that come together for a truly cinematic end.

Don’t just play the movies, live a whole new story experience in full VR!

Step into the shoes of an exorcist to confront ancient forces of evil when everything is at stake!

Discover an intricate story filled with mystery and peril.

Choose between HTC Vive or Oculus Rift headsets via SteamVR or purchase directly from the Oculus Store for an experience unlike any other. 

Switch between both free roam and teleport locomotion to have full control over your experience.

Play using room scale, standing, or even seated.

Utilize a menu consisting of a cellphone, an exorcism kit, among other important items found during the journey.

Unique items found throughout the stories are collected in your evidence room to be evaluated at a later time.

Chapters can be replayed at any time, enabling users to discover hidden story content, special achievements and easter eggs.

Chapter 1 and 2 will be out for PCs concurrently on November 22nd on Oculus Store and SteamVR, with a later release on Viveport and Playstation Network Store.

“This franchise deserves to be done right and the only way to have a truly definitive experience for such a story is in virtual reality,” said Douglas Nabors, CEO of Fun Train. “Playing a non-VR horror game is one thing when you’re safely behind a monitor. But, when you’re living the horror up close and personal, The Exorcist: Legion VR will resonate with you for years to come.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=x8Qx0FsaRAo&t=

notes.title: Good Things Come To Those Who Wait...
notes.content:
It’s overwhelmingly humbling how supportive our fans have been in wanting to see more about our game. That said, the fans and community are priority, always. But, due to a couple unforeseen speed bumps, we have to delay the release of Chapters 1 & 2. To ensure that both chapters are of the highest quality when released, we need to push them both back just a little bit.

Over the past 8 months we have been working as diligently and furiously as possible to get the game out and we can definitely guarantee that SteamVR and Oculus Store versions will be out November. We are slightly delaying the launch via Viveport and Playstation VR a little longer than that, so keep an eye out for those announcements.

Chapters 1 & 2 will launch simultaneously in each regard as planned. However, we are announcing today the name of the second chapter, “Idle Hands”, as well the pricing structure of the game.

“Idle Hands”, the next chapter of The Exorcist: Legion VR, will introduce players to an ex-schoolteacher who seems to have lost her mind and is set upon by some unseen force. What torments her? We look forward to showing you what unfolds in this thrilling second chapter.

We’re gamers too, and price is very important to us. “Chapter 1: First Rites” and “Chapter 2: Idle Hands” will launch at $4.99 each. We are extremely excited to be able to give VR and horror fans an incredible game for a reasonable and affordable price.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30779809/efec9a4640bced62967a037578f4eae5ad52c814.png[/img]

We will be discussing details, titles, and pricing for Chapters 3 - 5 at a later date, as well as announcing more definitive dates here very soon for our inaugural releases. To those that have voiced your patience directly to us, we salute you and wish you a great rest of your Halloween. Expect more announcements very soon!

Thank you!

-The Exorcist: Legion VR Team

notes.title: What's In A Name? Chapter One's Title Revealed!
notes.content:
It was a wonderful time deciding what to call the first chapter, but also a struggle. How do you capture the real nature of an event so terrifying with just a couple words?

Users arrive at their Boston precinct, get their bearings, and then are dispatched across town investigate a ritualistic crime where everything they have known gets turned upside down. There's blood, fear, and something very ancient to face which catapults them on a journey of discovery in future chapters.

We're excited to announce The Exorcist: Legion Chapter 1's title: "First Rites".

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30779809/c097fa0c95511d172e770dd2f663e83f863d3e1c.png[/img]

The Exorcist: Legion VR is coming soon to HTC Vive, Oculus Rift and PSVR
